2034-5220-6277-6441-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-6277-6441-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2317-4247-6763-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

443-4279-7918--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-7918--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2595-4694-5226-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4694-5226-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

767-4687-5268.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-4687-5268.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6495-6972-7936.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1170-2981-5131-7010--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

1999-4002-7340.easyPrerequisites:
Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
You control three or more lands that share a name.
1999-4002-7340.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sceptre of Eternal Glory from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sceptre of Eternal Glory from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

2034-3755-5223-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

579-1978-5793-7434.description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding four mana due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
579-1978-5793-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

2999-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2999-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2511-2946-4871-6112.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2511-2946-4871-6112.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

955-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3967-5508--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

3490-4050-4506-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4506-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

943-3664-4235-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, targeting Lotus Field
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Badgermole Cub's second ability triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Lotus Field.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Lotus Field
Repeat from step 2.
943-3664-4235-7008.notes: Once you have excess mana, you can untap other lands instead of [Land that Taps to Add Multiple Mana]].

1558-2638-3478-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3478-4231-4772.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2060-2908-4668-6930.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
2060-2908-4668-6930.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {U}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

141-997-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-997-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

1965-4616-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2905-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Pestermite.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite.
When the Pestermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pestermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

104-4186-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-4268.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1090-3086.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1090-3086.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lagrella and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Restoration Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Lagrella to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Lagrella and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Lagrella and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

645-997-1267-3908.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-997-1267-3908.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4289-5081-5231-5434.description:
Activate Obscuring Aether by paying {1}{G}, turning it face-down as a 2/2 creature.
Activate Obscuring Aether by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Obscuring Aether, adding {R}.
When Obscuring Aether dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down, then turning it face-up.
Repeat.

1495-4350-4613.notablePrerequisites: Butcher Ghoul has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4350-4613.description:
Activate Butcher Ghoul using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 until Butcher Ghoul has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Butcher Ghoul abilities dealing 1 damage to Butcher Ghoul, and any remaining damage to any target(s).
Butcher Ghoul dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Butcher Ghoul's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2091-2634-3593.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three tapped lands.
2091-2634-3593.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Mana Geyser.
Resolve the copy of Mana Geyser, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control four or more tapped lands, this combo nets infinite red mana.

472-1636-2825-5067.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
472-1636-2825-5067.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to cast a copy of Release to the Wind.
Resolve Release to the Wind, exiling Flaxen Intruder and allowing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled.
Cast Welcome Home from exile by paying {0}, creating three 2/2 Bear creature tokens and exiling Welcome Home.
When the Bears enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers three times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 two additional times.
Cast Flaxen Intruder from exile by paying {G}.
When Flaxen Intruder enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

703-2743-3633.notablePrerequisites: "Human" or "Wizard" chosen with Mirror of the Forebears.
703-2743-3633.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Mirror of the Forebears that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Choose to name "Human" as the Mirror of the Forebears tokens enter the battlefield.
Activate the three Mirror of the Forebears by paying {3}, causing each of them to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary and each Mirror of the Forebears trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

339-2011-3393.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
339-2011-3393.description:
Play Sandstone Bridge.
When Sandstone Bridge enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving Jegantha +1/+1 and vigilance until end of turn.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Najeela and Jegantha as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1475-3018-4050.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Rancor attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
1475-3018-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
One with the Kami and Rancor trigger.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Rancor trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

876-3291-4499.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least four.
876-3291-4499.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Karametra's Acolyte.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emiel.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

3809-4124.description:
Cast Whip Silk for {G}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk for {G}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

92-2298-3859.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than forty.
92-2298-3859.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life, targeting any creature.
Repeat step 2 until you have one life.
Resolve all Cavern Harpy abilities, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Oketra's Last Mercy by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing your life total to become forty.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose thirty-nine life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
